description.narrative: A program proposal (July 2017) has been submitted to Sweden's Embassy in Bolivia through the Resident Coordinator's Office in Bolivia entitled "COORDINATED GENDER STRATEGY ONE-UN IN BOLIVIA 2017-2020." The project proposes a UN Joint Action, for enhanced coordination with 5 UN organizations: UNFPA, UNICEF, UN Women, UNODC, UNDP and the co-ordinating Office of the Resident Coordinator (ORC) in Bolivia. The aim is to "promote gender equality in Bolivia under UNDAF-Bolivia strategy". The project is part of the implementation of UNDAF Bolivia's main program and further intends to secure commitment and ownership among UN organizations operating in Bolivia, as well as establishing a common framework for follow-up, learning and evaluation. The overall budget is in support of coordination and coordination. The program both means strengthening the results for gender equality per se as a methodology of strengthening coordination in ONE UN spirit without requiring co-programming. The program is for the period (2017-2020). The total amount sought for the project amounts to 3MSEK.

Ett programförslag (juli 2017) har inkommit till Sveriges ambassad i Bolivia genom Resident Coordinators kontor i Bolivia med titeln ”COORDINATED GENDER STRATEGY ONE- UN IN BOLIVIA 2017-2020". Projektet föreslår en gemensam FN-insats, för ökad samordning tillsammans med 5 FN organisationer: UNFPA, UNICEF, UN Women, UNODC, UNDP samt den samordnande ORC (Office of the Resident Coordinator) i Bolivia. Syftet är att "främja jämställhet i Bolivia inom ramen for UNDAF-Bolivia strategi”. Projektet ingår i genomförandet av UNDAF Bolivias huvudprogram och avser vidare att säkra engagemang och ägarskap bland FN-organisationer verksamma i Bolivia, samt att etablera ett gemensamt ramverk för uppföljning, lärande och utvärdering. Den totala budgeten går till stöd för koordinering och samordningen. Programmet innebär både ett stärkande av resultaten för jämställdhet per se som en metodutveckling vad gäller stärkt samordning i ONE UN anda utan att kräva samprogrammering. Programmet är fyraårigt (2017-2020). Det totala sökta beloppet för projektet uppgår till 3MSEK.

Increase the efficiency and sustainability of the actions implemented by the different agencies in the country for gender equality and the exercise of the rights of women, children and adolescents, which are articulated in the UNDAF 2018-2022.

sector.narrative: Women’s rights organisations and movements, and government institutions

description.narrative:
There are relevant indicators with target values. However the results has been delayed and the implementation of the UN reform as well.
During the first face of the construction of the project efforts has been done in order to ensure ownership from the UN agencies involve in the intervention setup. Meetings has been held bilateral with the UN agencies in order to take the temperature to this future process and to collect inputs for the construction of future actions. As a result of this initial dialogue it has been clarified that the construction of the program must be build in a participatory way.
The UN agencies involved (stakeholders) has recognized, that the process of UN reform regarding the improvement of coordination and increased alignment between the UN organizations needs to be further accelerated, in line with the recommendations from Triannual Comprehensive Policy Review (TCPR) (2004).This has driven a strong consensus from stakeholders to implement the ONEUN program in Bolivia. The results framework has include crosscutting issues that have been identified as important for the achievement of the outcome objective. During this first year an baseline values to measure indicators has been identified.
UNDAF Bolivia process and the work in Gender equality issues has been the entry to this program. Starting from the base to contribute to expected gender outcomes results in the UNDAF Bolivia. The following thematic areas of coordination have been identified in order to implement UNDAF Bolivia strategy: The right of women, children and adolescents to live without violence: Address the individual, social, cultural and structural conditions that limit effective prevention, care and punishment of violence against women, children and adolescents. Women's political rights: Addressing formal and informal constraints, as well as gender based obstacles to full participation in public life and social control.
Economic rights and empowerment of women: Address the constraints faced by women in order to develop and contribute fully to the economy, the different forms of exclusion, marginalization and discrimination they suffer in the workplace, their social vulnerability, and unpaid work develop in the domestic sphere and in the tasks of care of society. Sexual and reproductive rights of women, children and adolescents: Promote control and free exercise, without coercion, discrimination or violence of sexuality.
